# Where Did My Tokens Go?
**Realtime token badges beside the deep-thinking indicator — merged or split in/out, auto K/M/G/T un
its, per-step operation counts**
简体中文 · MIT License
> Where Did My Tokens Go? is a community-maintained DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin, not an official D
ns Go? is a community-maintained DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin, not an official DeepSeek AI product.
This README describes **1.9.3**.
## Features
Put "where did this turn's tokens go" directly in the transcript: a live counter rides the deep-thin
king indicator, and every finished operation row is tagged with the cost of its own step. The plugin
is global — once installed, every conversation gets it.
- **Live in / out badge**: after the blue 「深度思考 / 深度求索」 ("deep-thinking") indicator, a shimmer-swept
badge counts tokens while the model is thinking and streaming. The sweep reuses the platform's own

TextShimmer geometry, so the badge reads as part of the same sentence.
- `in N` = input tokens, `out

N` = output tokens, reasoning text included.
- **Both figures price the whole exchange, prompt cach
e included.** The provider's own `inputTokens` covers only the *uncached* part of the prompt (the AP
I subtracts cache reads and writes before reporting it), while a warm cache makes that part tiny — m
easured on a real transcript, cache hits were 99% of the prompt, so a 25K-token prompt reported 628
fresh tokens. The plugin therefore adds `cacheReadTokens` + `cacheWriteTokens` back onto the settled
figure, keeping it on the same full-prompt scale as the harness's live projection (`contextPressure
`). That projection prices the **next** request and is live during the input phase; the usage of the
request just finished outranks it, and before either exists the last known full prompt is reused. O
utput counts are estimated client-side while streaming (CJK glyph ≈ 1 token, latin ≈ 4 chars/token)
and snap to the authoritative value when the stream settles — reasoning text counts toward the same

`out` total, so nothing is double-counted and no separate thinking figure is printed.

After installing, **restart DSH** and open any conversation — the badge appears once you send a mess
age. Re-run the install command to update.
- Verified running on DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` (desktop profile, Windows); the host interfaces
the plugin depends on were re-checked against that release.
## Usage
| What you want | How |
| Watch this turn's in / out tokens | Send a message and read the badge after the 「深度思考」 indicator;

it counts in real time. |
| Switch merged / split | Open **Settings → Token 计数器** and click the matc

hing preview card. |
| Keep only in or only out | Toggle the other switch off — both preview cards d

rop the segment immediately. |
| See what each finished operation cost | Keep the `use` switch on; e

very 「已完成…」 row gets its own number. |
| Make big numbers readable | Leave units on auto, or lock K

/ M / G / T for a site in its gear menu. |
| Restyle one site | Gear → font size / color / unit. `0`

and "follow theme" mean no override. |
| Check before saving | Gear edits reflect in the preview ca
rds right away; the chat badge only changes when you press save. |
- **Three configuration entries**: **设置 → Token 计数器** (an own entry in the Settings navigation), the
configuration section on this bundle's page in the **插件 / Plugins** panel, and the "Token 计数器" card

in that panel's **官方 / Official** group. All three open the same form.
- **Unsaved drafts never lea
k**: preview and gear edits are staged inside the form; the live badge renders only saved configurat

ion; "save" writes the host config, "discard" reverts everything at once.
- **Fixed units still prom
ote stepwise**: locking `K` on an extreme number never prints `1000K`; it keeps promoting upward (ca

pped at `1000T`).
- **Reasoning text is not a separate figure**: it is part of the provider's `outpu
tTokens` (the platform validates `reasoningTokens <= outputTokens`), so it simply counts toward `out
` while streaming. Adding a separate `think` term on top of `out` would double-count, which is why t

he badge prints no thinking breakdown any more.
- **Reduced motion**: with the system "reduce motion

" preference, the sweep decoration is dropped and the numbers stay visible.
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
- The browser half subscribes to the DSH client `sessions` service and the active (main-view) sessio

n's `binding.eventSource`.
- It counts `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta` stream chunks as they arrive
(both feed the one output total), takes the input count from the authoritative usage first (`inputT
okens` + `cacheReadTokens` + `cacheWriteTokens`, i.e. the complete prompt) and from the harness's `c
ontextPressure` projection otherwise, and records authoritative `usage` per step from the `usage` ch

unk / `assistant/message` event (keyed by turn + step), ignoring its `reasoningTokens` field.
- It i
njects a DOM badge into the running indicator (there is no slot around it), rebuilt as two counter-m
oving layers mirroring the platform TextShimmer so the glyphs stay still while the highlight travels
. Each completed operation row is one step, so rows walked in document order claim the next settled

step of their turn.
- The host half declares the options schema with schemastery (15 fields); the se
ttings form reads and writes the same namespace through `configForms`.
